credits.author: Chris Meiers, PhD
credits.purpose: This app exists to build statistics muscle memory — the reflexes to read a mean, a p-value, or a confidence interval correctly without stopping to think — and, just as importantly, to practice turning data into visualizations that support leadership decisions.
credits.access: The LD 810 practice link is for students currently enrolled in my class at St. Martin's University. Everyone else is welcome to use the open practice mode.
credits.textbook: Salkind & Frey, *Statistics for People Who (Think They) Hate Statistics* (SAGE)
credits.textbook_note: I have been proud to teach from it across all levels of education since 2011. It is a tribute to my professors in the Department of Educational Psychology at the University of Kansas, where I earned my PhD, and my dissertation advisor, Dr. William Skorupski, who further inspired my love for data. Textbook-derived questions say so beneath the answer.
credits.quote: The grammar of science is statistics.
